evals.prompt: Everything for my next YouTube episode is in ~/Videos/ep12: four raw takes, the script, the thumbnail and some event clips. Cut the stutters and restarts, keep it natural, add an intro with the title and a jingle, captions, and use the left side of the frame for inserts.
evals.expected_output: An HDR-preserving edit (10-bit HLG master, graphics composited through a BT.2408 LUT, HEVC Main10 HLG output), with a phrase EDL, cut boundaries verified by re-transcription, an .srt, YouTube chapters, and a report listing what was verified and what must be checked by ear.

evals.prompt: Feedback on v1: the image looks warmer and lower quality than my rushes. At 1:22 and 4:01 you cut on my breath and I look down before the chapter card, which is too short to read. At 5:01 you cut me off before I finish the numbers.
evals.expected_output: Removes the SDR conversion from the pipeline instead of tweaking it, moves the segment ends before the inhale and gaze drop, gives chapter cards about 1.7 s of readable hold, extends the numbers segment to the true voiced offset, reruns head-down detection over the whole master, and answers each note in order.

evals.prompt: Now make me a 30-second vertical version for Instagram with only the juiciest moments, plus a caption for the post.
evals.expected_output: A 1080x1920 short cut from the clean HDR master with face-tracked crops, 2-3-word karaoke captions inside the Reels safe zone, the cover as the first frame, an end card pointing to the full video, a 9:16 cover PNG and an Instagram caption.
